patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been experiencing tingling pain in the sole of his right foot for the last 6 weeks, which occurs when he raises his foot above chest level during exercises. He started exercising regularly 2 months ago and notices his right calf cramps when using the incline feature on his treadmill, requiring him to stop frequently. The pain subsides after a few minutes of rest. He has been managing type 2 diabetes mellitus for 8 years. He is a smoker with a 34-year history of smoking two packs per day.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Tingling pain in the sole of the right foot during exercise
Secondary_Symptoms: Right calf cramps with incline exercise

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, managed with metformin for the past 8 years.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Smoking history of two packs per day for 34 years.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate a 55-year-old man presenting with foot pain and cramping during exercise, and diagnose the underlying condition.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doc, for the last six weeks I’ve had tingling pain in the sole of my right foot when I raise my foot above chest level during exercise. Also, when I use the incline on the treadmill, my right calf cramps and I have to stop, but the pain goes away after a few minutes of rest.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps with a dimple in the center on my skin.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—I haven’t noticed I need to urinate more often than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, I feel about the same overall—no major general weakness or loss of strength, it’s mostly the tingling in the sole when I lift my foot during exercise and the right calf cramps when I use the incline.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, I haven’t had any trouble dressing myself, and I can manage normally—this is mainly the tingling in the sole of my right foot during exercise and the calf cramps when I use the treadmill incline.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—there’s been no itchiness on my skin that I’ve noticed.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—my stools haven’t looked unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored to me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—my hands feel normal; I don’t have trouble gripping objects or opening jars. It’s mainly the tingling in the sole of my right foot during certain exercises and the calf cramps when I use the treadmill incline.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to stay conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, during those exercise episodes I stay conscious and aware the whole time—I don’t lose consciousness or black out; I just get the tingling in my right foot and the calf cramps and need to stop for a few minutes.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—I haven’t had any abdominal pain or discomfort.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—I've not had any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been in contact with anyone else who has similar skin lesions or rashes?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, I haven’t noticed any skin rashes or lesions at all, so I wouldn’t know of any contact with others having similar bumps.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you ever experience unwanted, distressing, or repetitive thoughts or images that pop into your mind and feel difficult to push away?
turns.patient_answer: “Doc, no—I don’t have unwanted, distressing, repetitive thoughts or images that are hard to push away. My concerns have been limited to the tingling in the sole of my right foot with certain exercise movements and the right calf cramps when I use the treadmill incline.”
